config.label: Q402 API key from https://q402
config.description: Q402 API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/dashboard. q402_test_* keys keep the server in sandbox mode; q402_live_* keys are required for real on-chain transactions.

config.label: Hex-encoded EVM private key used to sign payment authorizations
config.description: Hex-encoded EVM private key used to sign payment authorizations. Required only for real on-chain payments (live mode).

config.label: Set to '1' to allow real on-chain transactions
config.description: Set to '1' to allow real on-chain transactions. Any other value (or unset) keeps the server in sandbox mode regardless of API key tier.

config.label: Per-call USD-equivalent cap
config.description: Per-call USD-equivalent cap. Any q402_pay request with amount above this is rejected before signing.

config.label: Optional comma-separated lowercase EVM addresses
config.description: Optional comma-separated lowercase EVM addresses. When set, q402_pay rejects any recipient not on this allowlist.

config.label: Override for the Q402 relay endpoint
config.description: Override for the Q402 relay endpoint. Defaults to https://q402.quackai.ai/api when unset; useful for self-hosted Q402 deployments.
